map.艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线 · 卡片式记忆 · 多词库支持: The Ebbinghaus forgetting curve · flashcard learning · multiple word lists supported
map.选择词库后开始学习: Select a word list and start learning
map.👆 点击卡片翻转查看释义: 👆 Click the card to flip and see the definition
map.学习后的第1天遗忘最快，之后逐渐减缓: Forgetting is fastest on the first day after learning and gradually slows afterwards
map.建议在学习后 1天、3天、7天、15天、30天 各复习一次: Scheduled automatically by review count: the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th review are spaced 1/3/7/15/30 days apart, then fixed at 30 days. The "due today" counter at the top shows how many words in the current book are waiting for review
map.今天没有到期的复习单词（复习间隔 1/3/7/15/30 天）: No words are due for review today (intervals: 1/3/7/15/30 days)
map.将单词分为「不认识→模糊→认识→掌握」四个等级，逐步推进: Words move through four levels: don't know → vague → know → mastered
map.建议每天学习15-30个新单词，同时复习旧单词: Learn 15-30 new words a day while reviewing the old ones
map.示例：卡面「apple」，翻面 /ˈæp.əl/ 苹果。: Example: the front shows apple and the back shows /ˈæp.əl/ with its Chinese meaning.
map.单词记忆是一款教育学习领域的在线工具。: Word Memory is an online tool in the education and learning domain.
Enter a word or its meaning...
map.🎉 本词库已全部掌握: 🎉 All words in this list are mastered
map.今天没有到期的复习单词: No words are due for review today
map.按复习次数自动排程——第 1/2/3/4/5 次复习后分别间隔 1/3/7/15: Scheduling is automatic by review count: after the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th review the intervals are 1/3/7/15/30 days respectively, then a fixed 30 days. The "due today" counter at the top shows how many words in the current list are waiting for review.
map.📚 深度解析：内置英语单词卡（音标+释义）进行翻卡与自测，按 1/3/7/15/: 📚 In-depth: built-in English flashcards (phonetics + meaning) for flipping and self-testing, with reviews scheduled automatically at 1/3/7/15/30-day intervals.
map.翻卡识记：正面单词、反面音标与释义。: Flip to learn: the word on the front, phonetics and meaning on the back.
map.标记：不认识/模糊/认识/掌握四级分流，未掌握的单词留在队列中反复出现。: Marking: words are split into four levels — don't know / vague / know / mastered; words not yet mastered stay in the queue and come round again.
map.复习排程：按复习次数自动计算下次到期日（1/3/7/15/30 天），顶部显示今: Review scheduling: the next due date is computed automatically from the review count (1/3/7/15/30 days); the top bar shows how many words are due today, and due words are reviewed first.
map.内置基础词表，学习进度仅保存在本机 localStorage。: A basic word list is built in, and learning progress is stored only in your browser's localStorage.
map.点击标记会记录复习次数与时间，并按 1/3/7/15/30 天间隔生成下一次到期: Clicking a mark records the review count and time and sets the next due date at 1/3/7/15/30-day intervals; words marked don't know / vague are placed at the front of the review queue.
